regime_context: Hong Kong theme ranks show narrow, mixed leadership: Banks (H+HK) and Energy hold the top two slots with near-identical momentum scores (1.448 vs 1.403) and both are eligible behind the absolute-trend gate, alongside High-Dividend Blue Chips and Conglomerates & Exchange. Rotation breadth is narrow (4 of 17 eligible, frac 0.24) and one_narrative is false, so this is NOT a dominant single-narrative market; durability is split (Energy breadth 0.80/hurst trend vs Banks breadth 0.538/hurst mixed). The only scorable themes (China Tech & Internet, China Platform Megacaps) rank 14th/15th, are ineligible, and the platform megacaps carry a mean-revert hurst tag.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Energy (H-shares) can sustain its durability edge over Banks: the rotation margin between them is only 0.045, and a confirmed handoff (Energy score clearing Banks by a widening gap while Energy breadth stays above 0.70 and Banks breadth fades below 0.50) would retire this watch in Energy's favour.

theses.subject: Energy (H-shares)
theses.thesis: Energy is the best-structured eligible theme: highest durability_bar (0.79) with a trend hurst tag and the widest breadth (0.80), just a hair behind Banks on momentum score. The only validated leg (absolute-trend gate) approves it, and its texture (trend + broad participation) is the most coherent of the eligible names. This is a durability/trend-gate endorsement of the prevailing flow rather than a momentum forecast.
theses.dissent: The margin between Energy and Banks is razor-thin (0.045) and Energy is unscorable (no ETF proxy), so any lean is hard to grade and the 'trend' read could just be a short cyclical bounce already extended.

falsifier.text: Energy (H-shares) closes below its 20-day moving average while breadth falls under 0.50 before the check-by date.

check.reason: theme has no scalar etf_proxy → not cleanly scorable

theses.subject: High-Dividend Blue Chips
theses.thesis: High-Dividend Blue Chips is eligible behind the trend gate with a trend hurst tag and moderate breadth (0.625), making it the cleanest low-vol income-style tilt among approved themes. It is not crowded (crowding_z 0.02). Rank 3 with score 1.015 supports keeping a defensive eligibility lean in a market with no single dominant narrative.
theses.dissent: It is the lowest-scoring of the three eligible leaders and offers no relative-momentum distinction; a broad risk-on switch into growth would leave it lagging and the lean would quietly underperform.

falsifier.text: High-Dividend Blue Chips underperforms the Hang Seng by 3% while its durability_bar falls below 0.50 before the check-by date.

check.reason: theme has no scalar etf_proxy → not cleanly scorable

theses.subject: China Tech & Internet
theses.thesis: China Tech & Internet (proxy 3033.HK) is the only scorable tech theme and it is rank 14 with a negative score (-0.705), ineligible behind the absolute-trend gate, with weak breadth (0.211) and a mixed hurst tag. Given the trend gate is the one validated edge here, staying out of an ineligible weak-breadth theme is the discipline-consistent read, not a prediction.
theses.dissent: Tech in Hong Kong mean-reverts hard and China Tech is cheap on any narrative surprise; an unscheduled positive policy headline (macro_narrative unscheduled_share 1.0) could spark a violent rotation into exactly this beaten-down theme.

falsifier.text: China Tech & Internet (3033.HK) gains 8% relative to the Hang Seng and flips to eligible behind the trend gate before the check-by date.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
